entities.name: Eula Blue
entities.description: Shield mage from New Capenna invited to the first multiplanar class of Strixhaven; an ember.

entities.description: Eula's home plane, devastated by war.

entities.description: Mysterious classmate who became Eula's partner.

entities.description: Tasked with punishing the five students.

events.summary: War devastates New Capenna and Eula's hopes of magical education, but opens travel between planes.
events.quote: before the fight for the Multiverse devastated her home

events.summary: Eula accepts an invitation to Strixhaven's first multiplanar class.
Eula bonds with Alandra, Segante, Jamira and Kequia.
events.quote: Eula shared a bedroom with Alandra

events.summary: Eula copies spells from the Biblioplex and mails them to her father.
events.quote: Eula early on started copying spells from the Biblioplex

events.summary: Kasmina secretly works to create tensions among the classmates.
events.quote: Professor Kasmina endeavored to create tensions between the classmates.

events.summary: Eula discovers she can make black-mana shields; the Arcavios Preservation Society abducts her and Segante saves her.
Kasmina's plot to force the students to ignite and steal their sparks is thwarted; she presumably dies in a snarl.
events.quote: Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl

events.summary: Professor Vess lets the five stay and pledge to their colleges but forbids moving to the appropriate dorms.
events.quote: She allowed them to stay on and pledge to their individual colleges

relations.quote: to rob their sparks to reignite her own
which led to them starting an intimate relationship
